decision_table.name: Determine_RI_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file RI state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in RI (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets RI economic nexus threshold ($100,000 or 200 transactions)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
RI filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: RI Form RI-1120C Instructions (Corporate Income Tax Return) Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-2 (Tax imposed) Reference: RI Division of Taxation Regulation CT 17-01 (Nexus Standards)

RI filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 in gross receipts from Rhode Island sources or 200 transactions.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: RI Division of Taxation Regulation SU 17-21 (Economic Nexus) Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-1 (Definitions and nexus standards)
No RI nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_RI_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate RI state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
RI state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction - Federal bonus depreciation not allowed by RI - IRC Section 163(j) interest limitation differences
Subtractions may include: - Interest on Rhode Island state and municipal obligations - Capital gains on certain qualified Rhode Island investments - Rhode Island net operating loss deduction (limited carryforward)
Reference: RI Form RI-1120C Instructions (Schedule M-1RI Adjustments) Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-11 (Deductions and adjustments) Reference: RI Division of Taxation Regulation CT 18-04 (NOL deduction)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_RI_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate RI state corporate income tax. Applies 7% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
RI state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to RI: × [Single-sales apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Federal interest, 199A addback, bonus depreciation, etc.] 4. State subtractions: - [RI municipal interest, qualified capital gains, NOL] 5. RI taxable income: = [Result] 6. RI tax rate: × 7.0% (flat rate) 7. RI income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. RI credits: - [Historic Preservation, R&D, film, renewable energy credits] 9. RI tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: RI Form RI-1120C Instructions (Corporate Income Tax Return) Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-2 (Corporate income tax - 7% rate) Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-21.2 (Single-sales factor apportionment) Reference: RI Division of Taxation Regulation CT 19-03 (Tax credits)
No RI nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.

No RI taxable income - no tax liability. RI NOL carryforward rules may apply (limited to certain tax years).
Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-11 (Net operating loss deduction) Reference: RI Division of Taxation Regulation CT 18-04 (NOL carryforward)
